children: AEye secured a multi-million-dollar commercial engagement to supply its Apollo long-range lidar for Lunar Outpost’s Pegasus Lunar Terrain Vehicle.
AEye’s Apollo lidar selected by Lunar Outpost for integration on Pegasus LTV to support Artemis astronaut transport.
Contract marks AEye’s entry into the space mobility market, diversifying beyond automotive, defense, and industrial sectors.
Apollo chosen for rugged solid-state design, software-defined tuning, and compact form factor suited to lunar vacuum and thermal extremes.
Lidar will support terrain perception, obstacle detection and autonomous navigation to help traverse and protect crews and vehicle.
